Product Owner – Mobile App (Retail)
Greenleaf Grocers · Chennai, India (Hybrid)

Greenleaf Grocers is growing its mobile app for online grocery orders. We need a Product Owner to work with a Scrum team of eight to deliver new features for our customers every two weeks.

Your responsibilities
- Own and prioritise the product backlog for the mobile app.
- Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria.
- Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and sprint reviews with the Scrum Master.
- Gather feedback from customers, store teams and the marketing department.
- Accept completed work and make sure it meets the definition of done.
- Track app metrics such as conversion, basket size and app ratings.

Must have
- At least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a similar role in an Agile team.
- Hands-on experience with Scrum and backlog tools such as Jira.
- Strong skills in writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
- Good communication skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.

Nice to have
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or PSPO certification.
- Experience with mobile apps or e-commerce.
- Basic understanding of UX design and wireframing tools such as Figma.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter and a rockstar team player.

We offer employee discounts, health cover and a friendly team. Greenleaf Grocers is an equal opportunity employer.
